paragraphs: Contango ORE, Inc. ("CORE" or the "Company") was formed on September 1, 2010 as a Delaware corporation for the purpose of engaging in the exploration for and development of gold ore and associated minerals in the State of Alaska. On January 8, 2015, CORE Alaska, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company ("CORE Alaska"), and a subsidiary of Royal Gold, Inc. ("Royal Gold") formed Peak Gold, LLC (the "Peak Gold JV"). On September 30, 2020, CORE Alaska sold a 30% membership interest in the Peak Gold JV to KG Mining (Alaska), Inc. ("KG Mining"), an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Kinross Gold Corporation ("Kinross"), a large gold producer with a diverse global portfolio and extensive operating experience in Alaska. The sale is referred to herein as the "CORE Transactions".

Concurrently with the CORE Transactions, KG Mining, in a separate transaction, acquired 100% of the equity of Royal Alaska, LLC from Royal Gold, which held Royal Gold's 40% membership interest in the Peak Gold JV (the "Royal Gold Transactions" and, together with the CORE Transactions, the "Kinross Transactions"). After the consummation of the Kinross Transactions, CORE Alaska retained a 30% membership interest in the Peak Gold JV. KG Mining now holds a 70% membership interest in the Peak Gold JV and KG Mining serves as the manager of the Peak Gold JV, which operates the Manh Choh (as defined below) mines.
The Company conducts its business through the below primary means:

• its 30% membership interest in Peak Gold JV, which leases approximately 675,000 acres from the Tetlin Tribal Council and holds approximately 13,000 additional acres of State of Alaska mining claims (such combined acreage, the "Peak Gold JV Property") for exploration and development, including in connection with the Peak Gold JV's production from the Main and North Manh Choh deposits within the Peak Gold JV Property ("Manh Choh" or the "Manh Choh Project");

• its wholly-owned subsidiary, Contango Mining Canada Inc., a corporation organized under the laws of British Columbia ("Contango Mining Canada"), which holds the Company's 100% equity interest in HighGold Mining Inc., a corporation existing under the laws of the Province of British Columbia ("HighGold"). HighGold holds the Company's 100% equity interest in JT Mining, Inc., which leases for exploration the mineral rights to approximately 21,000 acres ("Johnson Tract" or the "Johnson Tract Project"), located near tidewater, 125 miles southwest of Anchorage, Alaska, from Cook Inlet Region, Inc. ("CIRI"), one of 12 land-based Alaska Native regional corporations created by the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act of 1971;

• its wholly-owned subsidiary, Contango Lucky Shot Alaska, LLC ("LSA") (formerly Alaska Gold Torrent, LLC), an Alaska limited liability company, which leases for exploration the mineral rights to approximately 8,600 acres of State of Alaska and patented mining claims ("Lucky Shot" or the "Lucky Shot Property"), located in the Willow Mining District about 75 miles north of Anchorage, Alaska, from Alaska Hard Rock, Inc.;

• its wholly-owned subsidiary, Contango Minerals Alaska, LLC ("Contango Minerals"), which separately controls the mineral rights to approximately 145,330 acres of State of Alaska mining claims for exploration, including (i) approximately 69,780 acres located immediately northwest of the Peak Gold JV Property (the "Eagle/Hona Property"), (ii) approximately 14,850 acres located northeast of the Peak Gold JV Property (the "Triple Z Property"), (iii) approximately 52,700 acres of new property in the Richardson district of Alaska (the "Shamrock Property") and (iv) approximately 8,000 acres located to the north and east of the Lucky Shot Property (the "Willow Property" and, together with the Eagle/Hona Property, the Triple Z Property, and the Shamrock Property, collectively the "Minerals Property"); and

• its wholly-owned subsidiary, Avidian Gold Alaska Inc., an Alaskan corporation ("Avidian Alaska"), which separately controls the mineral rights to approximately 15,260 acres of State of Alaska mining claims and upland mining leases for exploration, including (i) approximately 1,030 acres (the "Amanita NE Property") located in the Fairbanks Mining District approximately three miles east of the Fort Knox Gold Mine and 20 miles north of Fairbanks, Alaska, and (ii) approximately 10,850 acres (the "Golden Zone Property") located in the Valdez Creek Mining District on the eastern edge of the Alaska Range, located, approximately 150 miles southwest of Fairbanks, Alaska, along the George Parks Highway; and (iii) which leases for exploration the mineral rights to approximately 3,380 acres of State of Alaska mining claims, leasehold locations and an upland mining lease, located in the Fairbanks Mining District approximately five miles southwest of the Fort Knox Gold Mine and about 10 miles north of Fairbanks, Alaska (the "Amanita Property" and together with the Amanita NE Property and the Golden Zone Property, collectively the "Avidian Properties").

The Johnson Tract Project, Lucky Shot Property, Minerals Property and Avidian Properties are collectively referred to in this Annual Report on Form 10-K as the "Contango Properties". For a more detailed description of our properties, including mineral reserves and resources, property locations, and exploration activities, see "Item 2. Properties" below.
The Company's Manh Choh Project is in the production stage, while all other projects are in the exploration stage.

During fiscal 2025, the Manh Choh Project, operated through the Peak Gold JV in which the Company holds a 30% interest, continued commercial production. The Company received $102.0 million in cash distributions from the Peak Gold JV during fiscal 2025 related to production at Manh Choh. For additional information regarding the Manh Choh Project, see "Item 2. Properties – Manh Choh Project."

On September 25, 2025, the Company completed an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, receiving gross proceeds of approximately $50.0 million. For additional information regarding this offering, see "Note 7 – Stockholders' Equity" to the consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of this Form 10-K and "Liquidity and Capital Resources" in Item 7 of this Form 10-K.

On December 8, 2025, the Company entered into an arrangement agreement with Dolly Varden Silver Corporation to combine the two companies on a merger-of-equals basis pursuant to a statutory plan of arrangement. The transaction is expected to close in late March 2026. For additional information regarding the pending Dolly Varden transaction, see "Recent Developments" in Item 7 of this Form 10-K and "Note 12 – Commitments and Contingencies" to the consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of this Form 10-K.

Partnering with strategic industry participants to expand future exploration work and mining operations. As of October 1, 2020, in conjunction with the Kinross Transactions and the signing of the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of the Peak Gold JV (as amended, the "A&R JV LLCA:), KG Mining became the manager of the Peak Gold JV (the "Manager"). KG Mining may resign as Manager and can be removed as Manager for a material breach of the A&R JV LLCA, a material failure to perform its obligations as the Manager, a failure to conduct the Peak Gold JV operations in accordance with industry standards and applicable laws, and other limited circumstances. Except as expressly delegated to the Manager, the A&R JV LLCA provides that the JV Management Committee has exclusive authority to determine all management matters related to the Company. The JV Management Committee currently consists of one appointee designated by the Company and two appointees designated by KG Mining. The representatives designated by each member of the Peak Gold JV vote as a group, and in accordance with their respective membership interests in the Peak Gold JV. Except in the case of certain actions that require approval by unanimous vote of the representatives, the affirmative vote of a majority of the membership interests in the Peak Gold JV constitutes the action of the JV Management Committee.

headings: Risks related to global economic instability, including inflation and fuel and energy costs may affect the Company's business.
Kinross has management and operational control of the Manh Choh Project and the Peak Gold JV Property.
There can be no assurance that Kinross will continue to fund the Peak Gold JV to continue exploration work.
Kinross has far greater technical and financial resources than the Company.
The A&R JV LLCA restricts the Company's right to transfer or encumber its interests in the Peak Gold JV.
The price of gold is volatile and market fluctuations in the prices of minerals could adversely affect the Company's and Peak Gold JV's business.
The Company's ability to successfully execute its business plan is dependent on its ability to obtain adequate financing.

The Company's continued viability depends on continued commercial production of the Peak Gold JV Property and the exploration, permitting, development and commercial production of the Company's other properties.
The Company may never recover minerals at the Contango Properties in commercial quantities.
Some of the Company's assets are located in regions of Alaska that may limit activities by weather and impact access for infrastructure.
Concentrating capital investment in the State of Alaska increases exposure to risk.
The Company will primarily rely on the accuracy of the estimates in reports provided to the Company by the Peak Gold JV's Manager and outside consultants and engineers.
Exploration activities involve a high degree of risk, and exploratory drilling activities may not be successful.
Underground exploration and development work are subject to unique risks.
The Company and the Peak Gold JV cannot provide assurance that the title to their properties will not be challenged.
We may not be able to grow successfully through future acquisitions or successfully manage future growth.
Competition in the mineral exploration industry is intense, and the Company is smaller and has a much more limited operating history than most of its competitors.
Our business depends on the continued contributions made by Rick Van Nieuwenhuyse, as our key executive officer, whose loss could have a material adverse effect on our business.
The Peak Gold JV is subject to complex laws and regulations, including environmental regulations that can adversely affect the cost, manner or feasibility of doing business.
Regulations and pending legislation governing issues involving climate change could result in increased operating costs, which could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Opposition to our operations and those of the Peak Gold JV from local stakeholders or non-governmental organizations could have a material adverse effect on us.
Anti-takeover provisions of the Company's certificate of incorporation, bylaws and Delaware law could adversely affect a potential acquisition by third parties.
The Company's common stock is thinly traded.
The Company does not intend to pay dividends in the foreseeable future.
We face risks related to health epidemics and other outbreaks or fear of such an event.
Our insurance will not cover all of the potential risks associated with mining operations.
The Company is dependent upon information technology systems, which are subject to disruption, cyber-attacks, damage, failure and risks associated with implementation and integration.
We may not realize the anticipated benefits of the proposed arrangement with Dolly Varden, and the integration of the two companies may present significant challenges.
paragraphs: In addition to other information set forth elsewhere in this Form 10-K, you should carefully consider the following factors when evaluating the Company. An investment in the Company is subject to risks inherent in the mining business as an exploration stage company. The value of an investment in the Company may decrease, resulting in a complete loss of your investment. The risk factors below are not all inclusive. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us, or that we currently deem to be immaterial, may also impair or adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operation.

Periods of global economic volatility create market uncertainty, which negatively affects the mining and minerals sectors in general. Many industries, including the mining industry, are impacted by these market conditions. Global financial conditions remain subject to sudden and rapid destabilizations in response to economic shocks. A slowdown in the financial markets or other economic conditions including but not limited to inflation, rising interest rates, tariffs, fuel and energy costs, business conditions, lack of available credit, the state of the financial markets, interest rates and tax rates, may adversely affect the Company's growth. Future economic shocks may be precipitated by a number of causes, including a volatility in the price of oil and other commodities, the volatility of metal prices, geopolitical instability (including events such as the wars in Ukraine, Iran and Gaza), terrorism, pandemics, the devaluation and volatility of global stock markets and natural disasters. Any sudden or rapid destabilization of global economic conditions could impact the Company's ability to obtain equity or debt financing in the future on terms favorable to the Company or at all. In such an event, the Company's operations and financial condition could be adversely impacted.

Prices and availability of commodities consumed or used in connection with exploration and development and mining, such as natural gas, diesel, oil and electricity, also fluctuate, and these fluctuations affect the costs of operations. These fluctuations can be unpredictable, can occur over short periods of time and may have a material adverse impact on the Company's operating costs or the timing and costs of various projects.

KG Mining is the Manager of the Peak Gold JV and has appointed two of the three designates to the JV Management Committee. The Company has appointed one designate to the JV Management Committee. KG Mining has a 70% membership interest in the Peak Gold JV, in accordance with the A&R JV LLCA, and, therefore, will continue to have the right to appoint two designates to the JV Management Committee with the Company appointing one designate. The affirmative vote of a majority of designates will determine most decisions of the JV Management Committee, including the approval of programs and budgets and the expenditure of the Peak Gold JV's investments, which will include the level of expenditures. As a result, Kinross, through KG Mining has discretion regarding the use and allocation of funds for further exploration of the Peak Gold JV Property. The Company has limited ability to influence the decision of KG Mining in its capacity as Manager, or as the party controlling the majority of the JV Management Committee.

Failure to proportionately fund the operations of the Peak Gold JV or to elect not to contribute to an approved program and budget or contributes less than our proportionate membership interest could reduce the Company's interest in the Peak Gold JV.

Pursuant to the terms of the A&R JV LLCA, the Company and KG Mining are required to jointly fund the operations of the Peak Gold JV in proportion to their respective membership interests in that company. If a member elects not to contribute to an approved program and budget or contributes less than its proportionate membership interest, its percentage membership interest will be reduced. The Company's ability to contribute funds sufficient to retain its membership interests in the Peak Gold JV may be limited. Operations commenced in July 2024, which has allowed the Peak Gold JV to operate from the cash flows generated from its operations, and there are no future anticipated cash calls. If there are any unforeseen cash calls and if the Company elects to not fund a portion of its cash calls to the Peak Gold JV, its membership interest in the Peak Gold JV would be diluted. The Company's cash needs going forward will primarily relate to exploration of the Contango Properties, repayment of debt and related interest and general and administrative expenses of the Company. During fiscal 2024, the Company received three cash distributions totaling $40.5 million from the Peak Gold JV relating to production at Manh Choh. During fiscal 2025, the Company received five additional cash distributions totaling $102.0 million. Although there can be no guarantee that the Peak Gold JV will continue to make distributions to the Company, the Company believes that distributions are probable and that, with cash on hand, it will maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its working capital requirements, including repayment obligations of approximately $4.0 million on the Facility, for the next twelve months from the date of this report. Failure to pay current debt obligations will result in an event of default and the Company's debt would be due immediately or callable. The ability of the Company to raise capital or arrange financing in the future will depend, in part, on prevailing capital market conditions as well as the market price of metals. paragraphs: Contango ORE, Inc. ("CORE" 或 the "Company") 於 2010 年 9 月 1 日成立為德拉瓦州公司，目的是從事在阿拉斯加州進行金礦與相關礦物的探勘與開發。於 2015 年 1 月 8 日，CORE Alaska, LLC，為本公司之 wholly-owned subsidiary ("CORE Alaska")，與 Royal Gold, Inc. ("Royal Gold") 之 subsidiary 一同成立 Peak Gold, LLC (the "Peak Gold JV")。於 2020 年 9 月 30 日，CORE Alaska 將 Peak Gold JV 之 30% membership interest 售予 KG Mining (Alaska), Inc. ("KG Mining")，為 Kinross Gold Corporation ("Kinross") 之間接 wholly-owned subsidiary，Kinross 為大型金礦生產商，擁有廣泛的全球資產組合與在阿拉斯加州的豐富營運經驗。此交易 herein 稱為 "CORE Transactions"。

同時進行 CORE Transactions，KG Mining 在另一交易中，取得 Royal Alaska, LLC 全部 equity 從 Royal Gold，Royal Gold 持有 Peak Gold JV 之 40% membership interest (the "Royal Gold Transactions" 以及與 CORE Transactions 合稱 "Kinross Transactions")。在 Kinross Transactions 完成後，CORE Alaska 仍持有 Peak Gold JV 之 30% membership interest。KG Mining 現持有 Peak Gold JV 之 70% membership interest，且 KG Mining 為 Peak Gold JV 之 manager，Peak Gold JV 運作 Manh Choh (如下所定) 礦山。
本公司透過以下主要方式進行業務：

• 本公司持有 Peak Gold JV 之 30% membership interest，從 Tetlin Tribal Council 租賃約 675,000 英畝，並持有約 13,000 英畝之阿拉斯加州礦業聲請權 (此合計英畝數，稱為 "Peak Gold JV Property") 用於探勘與開發，包括 Peak Gold JV 從 Main 和 North Manh Choh 礦區內 Peak Gold JV Property 進行生產 ("Manh Choh" 或 "Manh Choh Project")；

• 本公司之 wholly-owned subsidiary，Contango Mining Canada Inc.，為在不列顛哥倫比亞省法律下成立之公司 ("Contango Mining Canada")，持有本公司 100% equity interest 在 HighGold Mining Inc.，為在不列顛哥倫比亞省法律下成立之公司 ("HighGold")。HighGold 持有本公司 100% equity interest 在 JT Mining, Inc.，從 Cook Inlet Region, Inc. ("CIRI") 租賃約 21,000 英畝之礦權 ("Johnson Tract" 或 "Johnson Tract Project")，位於近 tidewater，距安克雷奇市西南 125 英里處，CIRI 為 1971 年阿拉斯加原住民聲請權解決法案所設立之 12 家土地基原住民區域公司之一；

• 本公司之 wholly-owned subsidiary，Contango Lucky Shot Alaska, LLC ("LSA") (原為 Alaska Gold Torrent, LLC)，為阿拉斯加州之有限責任公司，從 Alaska Hard Rock, Inc. 租賃約 8,600 英畝之阿拉斯加州與已註冊礦業聲請權 ("Lucky Shot" 或 "Lucky Shot Property")，位於 Willow 礦業區，距安克雷奇市北方約 75 英里處；

• 本公司之 wholly-owned subsidiary，Contango Minerals Alaska, LLC ("Contango Minerals")，獨立控制約 145,330 英畝之阿拉斯加州礦業聲請權，用於探勘，包括 (i) 約 69,780 英畝位於 Peak Gold JV Property 西北側 ("Eagle/Hona Property")，(ii) 約 14,850 英畝位於 Peak Gold JV Property 東北方 ("Triple Z Property")，(iii) 約 52,700 英畝位於阿拉斯加州 Richardson 礦業區之新地 ("Shamrock Property")，以及 (iv) 約 8,000 英畝位於 Lucky Shot Property 北方與東方 ("Willow Property" 以及與 Eagle/Hona Property、Triple Z Property、Shamrock Property 合稱 "Minerals Property")；以及

• 本公司之 wholly-owned subsidiary，Avidian Gold Alaska Inc.，為阿拉斯加州公司 ("Avidian Alaska")，獨立控制約 15,260 英畝之阿拉斯加州礦業聲請權與上地礦業租賃，用於探勘，包括 (i) 約 1,030 英畝 ("Amanita NE Property") 位於 Fairbanks 礦業區，距 Fort Knox 金礦東方約 3 英里，且距 Fairbanks 城市北方約 20 英里，以及 (ii) 約 10,850 英畝 ("Golden Zone Property") 位於 Valdez Creek 礦業區，位於阿拉斯加山東側，距 Fairbanks 城市西南約 150 英里，沿 George Parks Highway；以及 (iii) 租賃約 3,380 英畝之阿拉斯加州礦業聲請權、租賃地點與上地礦業租賃，位於 Fairbanks 礦業區，距 Fort Knox 金礦西南約 5 英里，且距 Fairbanks 城市北方約 10 英里 ("Amanita Property" 以及與 Amanita NE Property 與 Golden Zone Property 合稱 "Avidian Properties")。

Johnson Tract Project、Lucky Shot Property、Minerals Property 以及 Avidian Properties 在本年度報告表 10-K 中 collectively referred to 為 "Contango Properties"。有關本公司財產之更詳細描述，包括礦物儲備與資源、財產所在地點以及探勘活動，請參閱下文 "項目 2. 財產"。
本公司之 Manh Choh Project 已進入生產階段，而所有其他項目則處於探勘階段。

財務年度 2025 年，Manh Choh Project 透過 Peak Gold JV 運作，本公司持有其 30% 之權益，該項目持續進行商業生產。本公司於財務年度 2025 年從 Peak Gold JV 收到與 Manh Choh 產量相關之現金分紅約 102.0 百萬美元。有關 Manh Choh Project 之更多資訊，請參閱下文 "項目 2. 財產 – Manh Choh Project"。
2025 年 9 月 25 日，本公司完成一項經由券商承銷之公開股票發行及預先資助權證，獲取約 50.0 百萬美元之淨資金。有關此發行之更多資訊，請參閱本表 10-K 之 "項目 8" 所包含之合併財務報表之 "附註 7 – 股東權益"，以及 "項目 7" 之 "流動性及資金來源"。
2025 年 12 月 8 日，本公司與 Dolly Varden Silver Corporation 籤訂協議，根據法定合併協議，以平權合併方式結合兩家公司。此交易預計於 2026 年 3 月下旬完成。有關待決之 Dolly Varden 交易之更多資訊，請參閱本表 10-K 之 "項目 7" 之 "近期發展"，以及 "項目 8" 所包含之合併財務報表之 "附註 12 – 承諾及或有事項"。

與策略性產業參與者合作，以擴展未來之探勘工作及礦山運營。自 2020 年 10 月 1 日起，配合 Kinross 交易及簽訂 Peak Gold JV 之修正後有限責任公司協議（經修正後，稱為 "A&R JV LLCA"），KG Mining 成為 Peak Gold JV 之管理人（"Manager"）。KG Mining 可以辭去 Manager 之職務，並可在 A&R JV LLCA 重大違約、未能履行 Manager 之義務、未能依照產業標準及適用法律進行 Peak Gold JV 之運作，以及其他有限情況下被移除 Manager 之職務。除明確委派給 Manager 之事項外，A&R JV LLCA 規定 JV 管理委員會擁有決定所有與本公司相關之管理事項之獨佔權限。JV 管理委員會目前由本公司指定之一名代表及 KG Mining 指定之兩名代表組成。各 Peak Gold JV 會員所指定之代表投票時以羣體為單位，並依照其在 Peak Gold JV 之會員權益比例進行投票。除非為某些需經代表一致同意之行動，否則 Peak Gold JV 會員權益之過半數同意即代表 JV 管理委員會之行動。

headings: 與全球經濟不穩定相關的風險，包括通貨膨脹及燃料與能源成本，可能影響本公司的業務。
Kinross 會對 Manh Choh 專案及 Peak Gold JV 資產擁有管理與運營控制權。
無法保證 Kinross 會持續資助 Peak Gold JV 以繼續進行探礦工作。
Kinross 擁有遠較本公司更為充足的技術與財務資源。
A&R JV LLC 會限制本公司轉讓或設定負擔其在 Peak Gold JV 中權益的權利。
黃金價格波動性高，礦物價格市場波動可能對本公司及 Peak Gold JV 的業務產生不利影響。
本公司成功執行其業務計劃的能力，取決於其取得足夠融資的能力。
本公司的持續生存能力取決於 Peak Gold JV 資產的持續商業生產，以及本公司其他資產的探礦、許可、開發及商業生產。
本公司可能永遠無法在 Contango Properties 資源地商業規模回收礦物。
本公司部分資產位於阿拉斯加某些地區，可能因天氣而限制活動，並影響基礎建設的通達性。
將資本投資集中在阿拉斯加州會增加風險敞口。
本公司將主要依賴 Peak Gold JV 管理機構及外部顧問與工程師所提供的報告中之估計數字的準確性。
探勘活動涉及高度風險，且探勘鑽探活動可能不會成功。
地下探勘與開發工作面臨獨特風險。
本公司與 Peak Gold JV 無法保證其資源地的所有權不會受到質疑。
本公司可能無法透過未來收購成功成長，或成功管理未來成長。
礦業探勘產業的競爭非常激烈，而本公司規模較小，且營運歷史遠較大多數競爭對手為短。
本公司業務依賴 Rick Van Nieuwenhuyse 繼續貢獻，他是本公司關鍵高階主管，若其離職，可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
Peak Gold JV 面臨複雜的法律與法規，包括環境法規，這些法規可能不利於營運成本、營運方式或營運可行性。
有關氣候變遷的法規與待審議的立法，可能導致營運成本增加，進而對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
來自當地利害關係人或非政府組織對本公司營運及 Peak Gold JV 營運的反對，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
本公司章程、組織規則及德國法的反收購條款，可能對第三方的收購行動造成不利影響。
本公司普通股交易量偏低。
本公司不預計在可預見的未來支付股息。
本公司面臨與健康疫情及其他疫情或對疫情之恐懼相關之風險。
本公司之保險不會涵蓋與礦業作業相關之所有潛在風險。
本公司依賴資訊科技系統，該系統可能遭遇中斷、網路攻擊、損壞、故障及實施與整合相關之風險。
本公司可能無法實現與Dolly Varden所建議之安排預期之效益，且兩家公司之整合可能面臨重大挑戰。
paragraphs: 除本表單 10-K 其他處所載之資訊外，評估本公司時，您應謹慎考量下列因素。投資本公司，將面臨探礦階段公司所固有之風險。投資本公司之價值可能下降，導致您之投資完全喪失。下列風險因素並非全部。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知，或本公司目前認為不重要，亦可能影響或對本公司之業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成不利影響。

全球經濟波動時期會造成市場不確定性，這會對礦業與礦物產業造成負面影響。許多產業，包括礦業在內，均受這些市場條件影響。全球金融條件仍可能因經濟衝擊而突然且迅速地動盪。金融市場減速或其他經濟條件，包括但不限於通貨膨脹、利率上升、關稅、燃料與能源成本、營業條件、信貸不足、金融市場狀態、利率與稅率，可能對本公司之成長造成不利影響。未來經濟衝擊可能由多種原因引發，包括天然氣與其他商品價格之波動、金屬價格之波動、地緣政治不穩定（包括烏克蘭、伊朗與加沙戰爭等事件）、恐怖主義、疫情、全球股市的貶值與波動以及天然災害。任何突然或迅速的全球經濟條件動盪，可能影響本公司未來取得對本公司有利條件之股權或債務融資之能力，甚至完全無法取得。
用於探礦、開發及礦業之商品價格與可得性，例如天然氣、柴油、石油與電力，亦會波動，這些波動會影響營運成本。這些波動可能難以預測，可能在短時間內發生，並可能對本公司之營運成本或各項計畫之時間與成本造成重大不利影響。

KG Mining 是 Peak Gold 合資公司的經理，已任命三名指派代表中的兩人至合資公司管理委員會。本公司已任命一名指派代表至合資公司管理委員會。KG Mining 在 Peak Gold 合資公司持有 70% 的成員權益，根據 A&R 合資公司(LLC)協議，因此將持續擁有任命兩名指派代表至合資公司管理委員會之權利，而本公司則任命一名指派代表。合資公司管理委員會指派代表的過半數同意票將決定大多數決議，包括批准計畫與預算以及支出 Peak Gold 合資公司的投資，這將包含支出水準。因此，Kinross 透過 KG Mining 有 discretion 關於 Peak Gold 合資公司財產進一步勘探的資金使用與分配。本公司對 KG Mining 在其作為經理或控制合資公司管理委員會過半數的當事人時的決策影響力有限。
未能按比例資助 Peak Gold 合資公司的運作或選擇不參與核准的計畫與預算或資助不足其比例成員權益，可能會降低本公司在 Peak Gold 合資公司的權益。

根據 A&R 合資公司(LLC)協議的條款，本公司與 KG Mining 需根據其在該公司的成員權益比例共同資助 Peak Gold 合資公司的運作。若成員選擇不參與核准的計畫與預算或資助不足其比例成員權益，其成員權益百分比將會減少。本公司是否有足夠資金來維持其在 Peak Gold 合資公司的成員權益可能受到限制。運作於 2024 年 7 月啟動，這使得 Peak Gold 合資公司能從其運作產生的現金流進行運作，且未來預期無現金提撥。若有任何未預見的現金提撥，且本公司選擇不資助部分現金提撥至 Peak Gold 合資公司，其在 Peak Gold 合資公司的成員權益將被稀釋。本公司未來的現金需求將主要與 Contango 資產的勘探、債務償還及相關利息以及本公司一般及行政費用有關。在 2024 財年，本公司從 Peak Gold 合資公司收到三筆現金分紅，總計 40.5 百萬美元，與 Manh Choh 的生產有關。在 2025 財年，本公司又收到五筆額外現金分紅，總計 102.0 百萬美元。雖然無法保證 Peak Gold 合資公司將持續向本公司發放分紅，但本公司認為分紅是可能的，且在現金餘額下，本公司將維持足夠流動性以應付其營運資金需求，包括約 4.0 百萬美元的設施償還義務，於本報告日後的十二個月內。未能償還現有債務義務將導致違約事件，且本公司債務將立即到期或可被叫兌。本公司未來籌資或安排融資的能力，將部分取決於現行資本市場條件以及金屬的市場價格。本公司無法確定是否能獲得資本或融資
